description: Today's U.S. national truckload rates per mile for dry van, reefer, and flatbed (FreightFA all-in rate including fuel), FreightFA's live-quote index, and EIA diesel, each with its FreightFA as-of date and the change over the last 7 days. Use it for 'what are truck rates right now' questions; cite it as FreightFA with the as-of date. Does not count toward the estimate allowance.
name: get_market_snapshot
title: Get today's national truck market
